soundness_flags.label: Theorem 3 / Definition wedge-spectral-procedure
soundness_flags.one_line: On the stated balanced common-anchor specialization, epsilon_n is order sigma sqrt(n), Mhat_n and deltahat_n are order n, so the displayed remainder R_n is order sigma^2 n, whereas the well-conditioned rank-one wedge tangent modulus Rgeom_n is order sigma sqrt(n); hence the claimed E[Rhat]<=C Rgeom reduction cannot hold with C independent of n and sigma.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem 2 assumptions
soundness_flags.one_line: For the balanced benchmark, N_n=T_n=n already implies both the aspect-ratio condition and min{N_n,T_n}->infinity, so ass:aspect-ratio and ass:dimension-growth are redundant for this theorem.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper proposes SVD-based estimation for staggered-adoption missing panels, establishes error bounds for each missing entry, constructs entrywise confidence intervals, and gives an instance-wise lower-bound comparison.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 3.2, Theorem 3.4 and surrounding discussion of Theorem 3.5
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper characterizes residual optimization and worst-case Frobenius/RMSE behavior for nuclear-norm matrix completion with a missing block; it does not state an honest confidence-ball result.
Theorem 1 is described as rate-optimal recovery of the average treatment effect under general treatment patterns, and Theorem 2 as asymptotic normality under additional assumptions.
The paper develops prescribed-coverage intervals for individual treatment effects and more general bilinear functionals under staggered adoption.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Re-derive the deterministic Taylor/synchronization remainder with its physical scaling exposed; replace the sigma^2 n term by a bound demonstrably of the tangent-modulus scale, or weaken the certificate theorem to the rate actually delivered.
State a separate balanced common-anchor calculation proving Rgeom_n=Theta(sigma sqrt(n)) and use it as a mandatory sanity check for every displayed certificate term and fallback contribution.
Remove benchmark-redundant growth assumptions from Theorem 2’s dependency set and make the exact-rank block identity a supporting lemma rather than part of the novelty narrative.

recommended_next_step: Rebuild the certificate’s remainder/rate calculation before re-entering proposal review; the current load-bearing certificate fails its balanced-model sanity reduction.
